title: Go database access
description: Connection lifecycle, request cancellation and transaction checks for Go services.

rules.instruction: Pass the request context into blocking database operations. Set deadlines at the boundary that owns the time budget.
rules.verification: Cancel a request in an integration test and check that the database operation and handler return within the configured deadline.

rules.instruction: Use the same transaction handle for dependent database statements. Handle commit errors and make rollback available on every failure path.
rules.verification: Test a successful write and a failure after the first statement, then read the committed state through a fresh query.

rules.instruction: Arrange cleanup of result rows on every return path of a streaming query. Check iteration errors before returning a complete result.
rules.verification: Repeatedly run the changed query against a test database, including an interrupted read, and confirm the connection pool remains usable.
